description:
Overview: The FUSION GADGETS 25W USB-C fast charger power adapter in white is built for users who want dependable, high-speed charging for modern USB-C smartphones, tablets and accessories. It is a compact everyday wall charger that fits easily into home, office and travel setups.

Fast 25W USB-C Charging: With up to 25W rated output and adaptive 5V / 9V profiles within its supported range, this wall charger helps reduce charging time on compatible devices compared to basic 5W or 10W adapters. Actual charging performance depends on your device’s fast-charging technology and the quality of the USB-C cable used.

Wide Device Compatibility: The single USB Type-C output port works with many USB-C Android smartphones, tablets, wireless earbuds cases, power banks and other gadgets that accept USB-C charging within the 25W range. It is suitable for daily home and office charging as well as travel when you need a reliable compact adapter.

Compact, Everyday Design: A slim, lightweight white housing makes the adapter easy to carry in pockets, laptop bags or travel pouches. The clean design sits neatly on wall sockets and multi-plug extensions without taking much space, making it suitable for desks, bedside tables and workstations.

Safety & Reliability: The charger is engineered with protection features against over-current, over-voltage and excessive temperature within normal operating conditions. When used with compatible devices and quality cables, it helps provide stable, consistent power delivery and peace of mind for everyday charging.

Ideal Use Cases: This 25W USB-C fast charger is a practical choice for users who want a compact primary or backup wall adapter for their USB-C phones and tablets, or a dedicated charger for travel and office bags while keeping their original charger at home.
